problem.local_reproduction: Five sequential GETs of https://www.tpex.org.tw/openapi/v1/tpex_mainboard_daily_close_quotes from the dev host on 2026-10-08 at about 12:10Z. Each declared Content-Length 4782391 with no Transfer-Encoding. Three bodies were complete. One ended at 3604073 bytes with no exception and failed JSON parsing ('Unterminated string'). One read raised TimeoutError ('The read operation timed out').
problem.cause: The official host intermittently ends a response early. http.client returns the short body without IncompleteRead when it is read with read(amt), and _read_bounded_response never compared it with Content-Length. The truncated body was treated as complete and failed in json.loads, which failed the connector run and the whole tick. A read timeout failed the run the same way. None of the four official fetch paths retried.

change: _read_bounded_response raises OfficialResponseTruncated (a SourceEvidenceError) when the response declares a Content-Length and the body is shorter. Without a numeric Content-Length the body is returned as read, as before.

_read_bounded_response reads until end of stream (empty chunk) instead of breaking on short reads, avoiding premature truncation on multi-chunk streams and short reads before EOF, while supporting static mocks in unit tests.

New _fetch_official(request, caller, timeout_seconds, max_bytes, parse) opens, reads and parses one official endpoint. It retries the same request only for OfficialResponseTruncated, TimeoutError, http.client.IncompleteRead and json.JSONDecodeError, up to OFFICIAL_FETCH_ATTEMPTS = 3 with 1 s and 2 s backoff. The final SourceEvidenceError names every attempt. HTTP errors, egress denial, the byte limit and all other errors are raised on the first attempt.
All four official fetch paths use it: TWSE/TPEx dataset payloads, per-symbol price history, TDCC CSV and TAIFEX JSON. Their parsing after the fetch is unchanged.
unchanged: Endpoints, headers, egress caller names, byte limits, parsing, record normalization, freshness and admission are unchanged. The copies of _read_bounded_response in social.py and alpha_db.py are out of scope.
test_changes: New services/source_ingestion/tests/test_taiwan_official_fetch_retry.py, 12 tests: a named truncation against Content-Length; a body without Content-Length; short chunk stream before EOF with Content-Length, without Content-Length, and via _fetch_official; truncation, read timeout or incomplete JSON followed by a complete response; persistent truncation failing after 3 attempts with 2 backoffs; HTTP error and byte limit not retried; and the adapter's dataset fetch going through the retrying reader.
